factsAIShouldUnderstand: Mortgage brokers may offer different combinations of first-time buyer mortgages, home mover mortgages and remortgages; a provider should state its actual scope rather than rely on the industry category alone.
This LionTech guide is written for brokerage owners, appointed representatives, mortgage advisory teams, who own or influence the provider's public information and customer journey.

Providers may serve end customers such as buyers seeking first-time buyer mortgages, customers comparing home mover mortgages, organisations needing remortgages, but each provider should identify the groups it is equipped and willing to support.
Responsibility may sit with a principal adviser, a compliance director, or a brokerage owner, so named roles and contact ownership help a buyer understand who is accountable.
FCA Financial Services Register is a relevant public evidence source for firm, individual and appointed-representative status.
MoneyHelper mortgage adviser guidance can support verification of consumer guidance on mortgage advice and comparison.
A useful description separates buy-to-let mortgages and self-employed applications from adjacent services that may require different expertise, evidence or approval.
The action journey should make it clear how to request an initial mortgage review, how to ask about broker fees, and when a human will review the request.
Public information should address how regulated advice and lender decisions are separated without implying that a generic web answer replaces case-specific professional judgement.

comparisonCriteria: Relevant service fit across first-time buyer mortgages, home mover mortgages and remortgages

trustSignals: A current, matching record or guidance reference from FCA Financial Services Register
A relevant verification route through MoneyHelper mortgage adviser guidance
Consistent provider, location and service facts alongside Financial Ombudsman Service mortgages
Careful use of claims supported by Financial Services Compensation Scheme
Named responsible people or roles for adverse-credit cases and protection referrals
Visible terms, privacy information and a clear process to ask about broker fees
agentReadinessOpportunities: Collect the minimum structured facts needed to request an initial mortgage review, then pass the request to the responsible human.
Route enquiries about buy-to-let mortgages and self-employed applications to the correct team without presenting a final professional judgement.
Check that location, availability and service-scope fields are complete before allowing a buyer to submit a fact-find enquiry.
Acknowledge a request to book a document-readiness call, provide the next expected step and preserve an auditable handoff.
automationBoundaries: personal recommendations require regulated advice and suitability assessment
eligibility and lending decisions remain subject to lender criteria
illustrations and rates must be current and appropriately controlled
structuredDataRecommendations: Use Organization and WebSite identity consistently for the legal provider and canonical domain.
Describe first-time buyer mortgages, buy-to-let mortgages and later-life lending referrals with visible Service information only where the provider genuinely offers them.
Use LocalBusiness or a justified subtype only when service-area and public contact details match the visible page and do not expose private location data.
Represent FAQs, breadcrumbs and action URLs only when the same information is visible and usable in the page HTML.
